# p0_aws_sqs_audit_logs (Resource)

Sends P0 audit events to an Amazon SQS queue, one JSON message per event.

To install:
1. Create a `p0_aws_sqs_audit_logs_staged` resource for the queue.
2. Create the `P0RoleIamEventSender` role in the queue's AWS account. It must trust P0's service account (`service_account_id` from the staged resource) and allow `sqs:SendMessage` on the queue. See the example.
3. Create this resource with the same `id`. P0 checks the role's policies and sends one test message to the queue.

Only one `p0_aws_sqs_audit_logs` resource is supported per P0 organization.

For the full install steps, see [Amazon SQS setup](https://docs.p0.dev/integrations/siem-integrations/amazon-sqs-setup).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "aws_sqs_queue" "p0_audit_events" {
  name = "p0-audit-events"
}

resource "p0_aws_sqs_audit_logs_staged" "example" {
  id = aws_sqs_queue.p0_audit_events.arn
}

# The role P0 assumes to send to the queue. Its trust policy and inline policy must
# match these exactly, or P0's check fails.
resource "aws_iam_role" "p0_event_sender" {
  name = "P0RoleIamEventSender"
  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect    = "Allow"
      Principal = { Federated = "accounts.google.com" }
      Action    = "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity"
      Condition = {
        StringEquals = {
          "accounts.google.com:aud" = p0_aws_sqs_audit_logs_staged.example.service_account_id
        }
      }
    }]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "p0_event_sender" {
  name = "P0RoleIamEventSenderPolicy"
  role = aws_iam_role.p0_event_sender.name
  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid      = "P0CanVerifyOwnRole"
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = ["iam:GetRole", "iam:GetRolePolicy"]
        Resource = aws_iam_role.p0_event_sender.arn
      },
      {
        Sid      = "P0CanSendToQueue"
        Effect   = "Allow"
        Action   = "sqs:SendMessage"
        Resource = aws_sqs_queue.p0_audit_events.arn
      },
      # Add for queues encrypted with a customer managed KMS key, and set
      # kms_key_arn on both P0 resources:
      # {
      #   Sid      = "P0CanEncryptForQueue"
      #   Effect   = "Allow"
      #   Action   = ["kms:GenerateDataKey", "kms:Decrypt"]
      #   Resource = "<kms key arn>"
      # },
    ]
  })
}

# Checks the role and sends one test message to the queue.
resource "p0_aws_sqs_audit_logs" "example" {
  id         = p0_aws_sqs_audit_logs_staged.example.id
  depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy.p0_event_sender]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ARN of the SQS queue P0 sends audit events to, in the form `arn:aws:sqs:<region>:<account-id>:<queue-name>`

### Optional

- `kms_key_arn` (String) The ARN of the customer managed KMS key that encrypts the queue. Omit it for queues that use SQS-managed encryption or the AWS managed key (`alias/aws/sqs`).

### Read-Only

- `state` (String) This item's install progress in the P0 application:
	- 'stage': The item has been staged for installation
	- 'configure': The item is available to be added to P0, and may be configured
	- 'installed': The item is fully installed
